selection: stratified by language x sentiment with rotated remainder to balance language and class totals
validation: No within-sample normalized exact duplicates; none overlap train/validation under casefold+whitespace normalization.
known_limitation: Synthetic template variations from 108 seed sentences; semantic near-duplicates across splits possible. Not independent real-world CX.
do_not_use_for: Threshold selection, prompt development, model selection, training or repeated leaderboard tuning. Use original validation.csv for threshold tuning.
